channel.title: Block Club Chicago - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Block Club Chicago (blockclubchicago.org)

item.title: Immigrant Father Of 3 Reunites With Family After Being Unlawfully Arrested During Midway Blitz
item.description: José Luis Téllez Fernández was detained — away from his children, his job, his dog — for weeks, even after immigration authorities told a federal judge they would release him. Hundreds of people unlawfully taken could still be detained, attorneys said.

item.title: Mike Quigley Faces 3 Democratic Challengers In 5th District Primary
item.description: Candidates vying for Quigley’s seat — which he’s held since 2009 — outlined their platforms on issues ranging from housing to government accountability at a League of Women Voters forum.

item.title: City Should Better Promote Being World’s ‘Blues Capital,’ Buddy Guy And Other Advocates Say
item.description: Chicago Blues Revival Executive Director Diamond M. Dixon hopes Chicago will take a page from cities like Nashville and New Orleans that have honored artists while blending culture with commerce.

item.title: From ‘Newsies’ To Nonprofit News: Journalism Takes Center Stage At Beverly Arts Center
item.description: The Beverly Arts Center’s Saturday afternoon production of “Disney's Newsies” will be followed by a discussion of the power of the press with local journalists, including Block Club co-founder Jen Sabella.

item.title: Crumbling Late 1800s Humboldt Park Church Could Be Converted Into 20 Apartments
item.description: The seventh proposal for the site might be the one that sticks as it's garnered mostly positive feedback from neighbors, the developer and Ald. Jessie Fuentes said.

item.title: Miss American Science & Surplus? Portage Park Vintage Shop Is Selling Its Inventory
item.description: Ecclection owner Julie Alleyne stocked up on treasures from the beloved novelty shop after stumbling on a warehouse sale after it closed.

item.title: New South Side Nonprofit Urges Neighbors To ‘Be The Village’ — And Show Up For People In Need
item.description: Based in Beverly, Be the Village was founded in 2025 with a focus on families helping families through meal and grocery assistance, home decluttering/organization and community.

item.title: Person In Custody In Killing Of Uber Eats Driver Outside West Side Hospital, Police Say
item.description: Daniel Figueroa, 28, was killed in a carjacking attempt after making a food delivery to Loretto Hospital Monday, according to police and media reports.

item.title: Double Door Owners Abandon Plan To Reopen In Uptown
item.description: Co-owner Sean Mulroney is moving on from the years-long plan to reopen the iconic Wicker Park music venue on Wilson Avenue. In the meantime, he's partnering with Gallery Cabaret owner Mike Strandberg at the legendary Bucktown dive bar.

item.title: Trader Joe’s Opening New Store In Logan Square
item.description: The grocery chain is taking over a long-vacant CVS building on Milwaukee Avenue, according to Ald. Daniel La Spata.
